title.zh: Binance will hold some Brazil crypto deposits until users explain where the money came from
title.en: Binance will hold some Brazil crypto deposits until users explain where the money came from

current_state.zh: Binance will begin requiring Brazilian users to explain the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers from Nov. 1, reporting the transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank under Resolution BCB 521/2025.
current_state.en: Binance will begin requiring Brazilian users to explain the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers from Nov. 1, reporting the transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank under Resolution BCB 521/2025.
